proposed_additive_gate.fixture_C: Original physical-unit PANEL Bass Stack source phrase T.retrigOn2=6.25 s quantized up to 64 host frames at 48/96 kHz; selected inactive voice6 in historical capture; independently observe pending idle-time catchup (7/15 internal samples in the historical trace) and take reference snapshot AFTER catchup but BEFORE assignment; check immediately after assignment, without rendering another sample; both ranks; deterministic replay must render byte-identically to a no-probe control. proposed_additive_gate.fixture_C_implementation_prerequisite: Root approval of a test-only isolated observer/friend or an independently qualified replay method that exposes private wake of selected voice and does not clock or mutate global/voice time twice. Do not compare pre-wake with post-assignment as if both represented the same time. No production edit authorized in this source-only proposal.
proposed_additive_gate.fixture_D: Standalone WSC cache-restart oracle at internal 96/192 kHz: run an oscillator at 261.6 Hz until it has a genuinely cached future event and at least one pending antialias residual; restore exactly its exposed state into a second independently prepared oscillator (which invalidates only the derived branch cache), then switch requested frequency to 1046.4 Hz, threshold from +0.15 to -0.45 V, or both. Require the next 128 outputs AND complete exposed continuation states to be bit-identical between the retained-cache and freshly searched controls, with no event-capacity overflow. This is an independent cache-strategy comparison, not an analog instrument oracle.
proposed_additive_gate.excluded_from_bit_equality: Gate stage enum, new-key identity, keyboard/touch selectors, elapsed stage coefficients or target frequencies which change by design, static lookup cache internals, padding bytes, and numerical states that really advance during legitimate pending idle wake
proposed_additive_gate.comparison: Bitwise by explicitly named integral/boolean and IEEE-754 scalar fields (including signed zero and residual matrix entries); do not memcmp structs with padding. Update the exposed-field manifest deliberately when the struct changes. No tolerance above zero.
